reviewPolicy: Entries fully represented by Affliction Forge 0.1.55 ship as full. Bonechill, Brain Worms, and Crimson Ooze are published as intentional manual-exception templates: supported staged mechanics are automated, while the unsupported environmental, confusion-behavior, or body-part rules are surfaced as visible GM guidance rather than driving bespoke engine subsystems.

notes: Stage 2 and 3 speed penalties use Affliction Forge 0.1.52 numeric PF2e modifiers.
The alternate cure by amputating affected limbs is handled manually and is not an engine blocker.
Muscle spasms are descriptive; the rules-facing Stage 3 condition is paralyzed.
Carrier status remains descriptive/transmission metadata and does not auto-propagate the disease.
Stages 2 and 3 use Affliction Forge 0.1.55 pre-action flat-check gates for concentrate spell casts and item activations.
Stage 3 locks fatigued recovery while active.
Later recurrence is handled by manually reapplying the same definition.
Stage 3 uses a 1d20-minute periodic stage effect that reapplies 1d6 persistent bleed damage.
Stage 2 uses Affliction Forge 0.1.54 condition-increased event reactions to add +1 to wounded whenever wounded is gained or increased.
The disease-wide affliction-damage healing restriction and Stage 3 complete healing lock are represented natively.
Virulent progression uses the native two-consecutive-success rule.
Affliction Forge 0.1.51 already covers the cold-damage healing lock.
Intentional manual exception: environment severity shifting is not planned as a generic Affliction Forge feature.
entries.manualComment: GM-Hinweis: In Phase 3 und 4 müssen die Auswirkungen kalter Temperaturen manuell um eine Schweregradstufe erhöht werden. Die ab Phase 2 erworbene Heilungssperre für Kälteschaden bleibt bis zur Heilung der Krankheit bestehen; fällt die Krankheit wieder auf Phase 1, muss diese fortbestehende Sperre manuell berücksichtigt werden.

notes: Hoarse voice in Stage 1 is descriptive; Stage 3 uses the speak capability restriction.
Stage 4 uses component-specific persistence so blindness is permanent while enfeebled 2 remains stage-bound.
The published slashing-damage version is represented; optional bludgeoning or piercing variants can be made as editable copies.
Damage-triggered secondary Will saves are handled by Affliction Forge 0.1.50 event reactions.
Affliction Forge 0.1.50 covers the damage-triggered secondary Will saves.
Intentional manual exception: confusion attack rewriting and the special confused-ending rule are not planned as generic engine behavior.
entries.manualComment: GM-Hinweis: Angriffe aufgrund von Verwirrt werden als Bisse abgewickelt. In Phase 4 beendet erlittener Schaden Verwirrt nicht. Diese Verhaltensausnahmen werden manuell abgewickelt.

GM-Hinweis: Die befallene Hand wird manuell verfolgt. Ihre Benutzung verursacht in Phase 2 3W6 anhaltenden Blutungsschaden; in Phase 3 ist sie unbenutzbar, in Phase 4 dauerhaft unbenutzbar. In Phase 5 beendet Schaden Verwirrt nicht. Amputation vor Phase 4 ist eine manuelle Heiloption.
notes: The alternate cure by amputation before stage 4 is a manual cure option, not an engine blocker.
Intentional manual exception: infected-hand use, hand usability/loss, and the special confused-ending rule are not planned as generic engine behavior.
